readerCopy.body: Visibility can land on a newer role, project, or identity before that direction feels fully established. When the Sun conjoins the North Node, recognition and forward movement meet, making authorship, leadership, a title, or putting a name on new work carry more weight than the size of the move suggests. The older identity may still be easier for others to recognize. Attention becomes useful when it reinforces what is being built now rather than pulling the direction back toward what is already familiar.
